skill.name: check-stock-and-returns
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to spot advertised products at risk of running out, review reorder suggestions, and compare return rates by category. Save lead times and safety buffers only after confirming the exact shop, scope, and values.
skill.summary: Compare shop inventory and returns with ad performance, then review reorder recommendations.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, Product Metrics documentation links, or shop queries rather than shell execution or host reconnaissance. Three CLI examples lack guidance on safely passing dynamic values, and the workflow does not require explicit shop selection when multiple shops are connected. No evidence was found of credential theft, exfiltration, or attempts to manipulate the audit.

remediation.issue: CLI examples leave dynamic values open to shell interpretation.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer structured MCP calls for reads where available. For CLI calls, pass validated values as separate arguments without invoking a shell, including for confirmed settings writes.

remediation.issue: Store selection is ambiguous when multiple properties are accessible.
remediation.suggestion: Ask which shop to use when the request is ambiguous. Identify the selected shop before reading its data and keep every call scoped to that shop.

content.user_title: Check Stock Risks and Product Returns
content.value_statement: Stock shortages can leave ads running for products that shoppers cannot buy. Use Product Metrics to compare ad performance with stock, review reorder suggestions, and see which categories have higher return rates.
actual_capabilities: Identify advertised products that are out of stock or could run out before restock.
Report stock on hand, weeks of cover, estimated stockout dates, reorder dates, and suggested quantities.
Find slow-moving products with excess stock and products in the Stars segment at risk of running out.
Compare product return rates across categories using the shop's configured category column.
Look up stock and margin for a specific product.
Save lead times and safety buffers at shop, brand, or product level after confirmation.
limitations: A connected Product Metrics shop is required. Stock, order, and inventory data require Pro.
Returns comparisons need a configured category column. Insights can be unavailable if data is missing or below the reporting threshold.
The CLI reorder-due list does not by itself show whether products are receiving ad spend.
The skill does not place orders or pause products or campaigns. Saving inventory planning settings requires editor or administrator access.

use_cases.title: Check Ad Spend Against Availability
use_cases.description: Find advertised products that are out of stock or may run out before restock. Review their ad results for the same reporting period.

use_cases.title: Review Reorders Before a Sale
use_cases.description: Compare stock on hand, weeks of cover, and suggested reorder quantities to decide which products to restock first.

use_cases.title: Compare Category Return Rates
use_cases.description: Identify categories with higher reported return rates and note any unavailable insights before choosing what to investigate.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Product
prompt_templates.prompt: For [shop], show the stock on hand, weeks of cover, and margin for [product]. Ask me to confirm the match if the product name is ambiguous.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review current stock and margin for one product.

prompt_templates.title: Find Ad Spend on Unavailable Products
prompt_templates.prompt: For [shop] and [period], list advertised products that are out of stock or may run out before restock. Show their ad results and keep campaigns unchanged.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Review inventory risk during an ad campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Review Reorders and Returns
prompt_templates.prompt: For [shop], list products due for reorder and their suggested quantities. Separately, show the categories with the highest return rates for [period] and note any missing data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Prepare an inventory and merchandising review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Confirmed Planning Update
prompt_templates.prompt: For [shop] and [brand], show the current lead time and safety buffer. Propose [lead time] and [buffer] days, then wait for my confirmation before saving.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Change one brand's inventory planning settings with editor or administrator access.

output_examples.input: Which products in my Main Shop received ad spend while out of stock last week?
output: Two advertised products in Main Shop were out of stock last week.
The Travel Mug had no stock on hand and received $85 in ad spend.
The Desk Lamp had no stock on hand and received $42 in ad spend.

output_examples.input: What should I reorder first for Main Shop?
output: Review the Canvas Tote first. It has 18 units on hand and about one week of cover.
The planner projects a stockout on May 14 and recommends reordering 120 units by May 7.

output_examples.input: Which categories in Main Shop had the highest return rates in April?
output: Footwear had the highest reported return rate at 12%, followed by outerwear at 8%.
The figures cover April 1 to April 30 and were last updated on May 2.
These rates do not explain why shoppers returned products.

best_practices: Name the connected shop and reporting period before requesting ad or returns data.
Check the data timestamp, insight status, and source footnote before acting on a report.
Confirm the exact shop, scope, and both day values before saving a planning setting.
anti_patterns: Treating a reorder suggestion as a purchase order or a confirmed delivery date.
Assuming a below-threshold or unavailable insight means there were no returns or stock risks.
Using inventory warnings as permission to pause campaigns or change ad settings.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: Connect your Product Metrics shop through MCP or the Product Metrics CLI. Stock, order, and inventory features require Pro.

faq.question: What does at risk mean?
faq.answer: A product is at risk when it is out of stock or expected to run out before it can be restocked.

faq.question: Can the skill place orders or pause ads?
faq.answer: No. It reports planner recommendations and stock risks for you to review and act on.

faq.question: How are lead time and safety buffer different?
faq.answer: Lead time is the number of days from ordering to receiving stock. The safety buffer is the extra days of stock the planner accounts for.

faq.question: Who can save inventory planning settings?
faq.answer: An editor or administrator can save an update after confirming the exact shop, scope, lead time, and safety buffer.

faq.question: Why is the category returns insight missing?
faq.answer: The shop may lack a configured category column or a required data source. The available data may also be below the reporting threshold.
